sentences.en: New York City is a microcosm of the world.
The comment section is a microcosm of the larger cultural debate taking place.
sentences.zh: 评论区反映了正在进行的更大文化辩论。

sentences.en: This stream is like a microcosm for studying the problems facing the wider ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 这条溪流就像是研究更广泛生态系统所面临问题的一个缩影。

senses.zh: 微观世界,小宇宙缩影小规模地形容词:microcosmic
